Find photos using a contact’s single e-mail address.

Gravatar receives a code derived from the contact’s e-mail address to look up a public avatar. No names, phone numbers or messages are sent. Photos may be applied automatically according to your selected policy. Manual choices remain protected.
Checked. Existing photos and uncertain numbers were left unchanged.

Choose the correct contact, or ignore this photo.
Find company logos using websites, business email domains or company names. Personal photos stay.

Dot Dialer checks public icons on company websites and business email domains. With your permission, only the company name is sent to Dot Dialer and Logo.dev for matching. Phone numbers, full email addresses, personal names and messages are not sent. Unclear matches need your choice; existing personal photos remain.
No usable site or logo is available. Add the company’s official HTTPS website to the contact.

Use sender avatars from WhatsApp notifications.

Dot Dialer reads sender identity and avatars from WhatsApp notifications. Messages are not saved or sent to a server. Photos are processed locally. Photos may be applied automatically according to your selected policy. Manual choices remain protected.
